title: Task sync refusals carry dedicated machine-readable codes
outcome: Task sync refusals carry dedicated machine-readable codes
acceptance: Each task export or import refusal (native execution state, divergent or removed planning state, foreign id collision, invalid graph, origin binding mismatch, destination refusals) carries a distinct stable code in a --json receipt, and the human text keeps its current reason

completion.summary: Each task export or import refusal now carries a distinct stable task_sync_* code in the CLI's --json error receipt: native state, divergent and removed planning, id collision, invalid graph, origin mismatch, and 13 destination leaves. The human text is byte-identical and the host wire code is unchanged. The codes are documented in docs/features/task-planning-text.md under "Refusal codes", with a test that checks the docs table. Full gate test-9b69c01f passed on freeze 0cabf8de. The round-5 Codex and Claude pair was clean at Medium and above. Evaluation 3bd19a94 passed. Landed as 0b5824b and installed as build d8e04d2d9317; all 5 stores report ready.
